_adapted: Adapted from affaan-m/ECC (MIT), commit d3b8a3e. Merged for Neva.

_comments.setup: A plugin cannot register a statusLine, so this is opt-in. Replace <neva-core> with the absolute path of the installed neva-core plugin, then copy the statusLine object into ~/.claude/settings.json.
_comments.display: Model, current task, session cost, tool count, files modified, session duration, directory, and a context usage bar.

colors.red: Context used 80% or more: you are in the last 20%, write state to a file and compact at the next milestone

_comments.dependencies: Reads the per-session bridge file written by the neva-core post_tool metrics_bridge hook. Without that hook the bar still shows context, but cost, tool and file counts are blank.
_comments.status: The Python statusline module is ported by the hooks agent. Until plugins/neva-core/statusline/statusline.py exists, this example does nothing.
